Update: Services appear to be gradually recovering after about half an hour, though individual situations may vary.

You are not alone. It's not just you—Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, and Grok all appear to be experiencing widespread outages, affecting many users.

The outage comes as OpenAI is in the midst of hyping up the launch of GPT-6 Astra.

ChatGPT is affected across web, mobile, and desktop versions. Claude also appears to be experiencing the same outage. SpaceXAI has also confirmed service issues with Grok.

The outage occurs as OpenAI is reportedly set to unveil its next-generation flagship model Astra as early as today. The new model may upgrade OpenAI's lineup from GPT-5.6 to GPT-6.

We will update our report as more information becomes available.
